title: Colombo National Museum

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified garden terrain near the center of the historic south facade.

mapIdentity.scope: The 25 native points hold the main building, projected portico and attached galleries. The Natural History Museum is a separate mapped building.

note: The original lawn elevation sets the entrance datum. The two-storey arches, prominent pediments and corner bays follow the 1896 view, with later wings represented within their surveyed perimeter.
